class And {
  value;
  constructor(flag: boolean) { flag &&= (this.value = 1) > 0; }
}
class Or {
  value;
  constructor(flag: boolean) { flag ||= (this.value = 2) > 0; }
}
class Nullish {
  value;
  constructor(flag: number | undefined) { flag ??= (this.value = 3); }
}

new And(false).value.toFixed();
new Or(true).value.toFixed();
new Nullish(0).value.toFixed();

function receiverOf(value: number, receiver: { flag: boolean }) { return receiver; }
class AssignedOnLeft {
  value;
  constructor(receiver: { flag: boolean }) {
    receiverOf(this.value = 1, receiver).flag ||= (this.value = 2) > 0;
  }
}
new AssignedOnLeft({ flag: true }).value.toFixed();
